title: Caliper roadmap candidates for one pillar
description: One pillar's candidates: ideas that are not in the registry, kept to mine as the product grows. A proposed pillar also carries a description and, when there is one, a fold-in alternative.

pillar.description: The registry prefix of an existing pillar, or the proposed prefix of a new one.

title.description: The pillar's name in Title Case.

proposed.description: True for a pillar that is not in the registry yet.

description.description: For a proposed pillar: one sentence on what it holds.

alternative.description: For a proposed pillar: where its candidates could fold in instead.

key.description: A stable lower-case name, unique across all candidate files.

title.description: A Title Case noun phrase under the docs title rule.

origin.description: cut: a scope cut. plan-idea: an idea in a plan. adjacent-work: from neighbouring work. field: from a scan of comparable tools.

depends_on.description: Registry feature ids the candidate builds on.
